name: The Kept Hearth
pitch: Whatever they throw at you feeds your ward, and what feeds you and what ends them are exactly the two conversions a hit is allowed.

new.name: Turning Phase
new.effect: When an art carrying an element reaches you, your ward's phase becomes what it generates, from your next hit on, and your Ring Steps start there, so they end at its overcomer.
new.second_home: any phased ward or element-tag build

new.name: Ring Step
new.effect: Up to 100 % of an art hit converts to the next element on the generating cycle, twice. Each part keeps every earlier tag.

new.name: Long Way Round
new.effect: +0.2 to a part's coefficient per conversion it went through.

new.name: One Ring
new.effect: A bonus to any one element's damage also applies to the other four.

new.name: Banked Heat
new.effect: +30 points to hits carrying two or more element tags.

new.name: Ring's Weakest
new.effect: +1.5 points to arts per point of your lowest owned element's purity.

new.name: Carried Tags
new.effect: +15 points to a hit per element tag on it.

new.name: Set Table
new.effect: Foreseen fights: you read the enemy's element at t = 0, and +30 points to arts.
new.second_home: any build that studies a target

new.name: Overcoming Stroke
new.effect: +60 points to a hit carrying the element that overcomes the target's.

new.name: Child Steals the Mother
new.effect: A hit whose element generates your ward's phase is Fed: pass_tag -0.25, the ward pays nothing, and you gain half of what it blocked.
new.second_home: any phased ward: a Fire ward that feeds on Wood

new.name: Mother-and-Child Ward
new.effect: A common drain ward, pass 0.54 and 0.36, drain 1.0 and 1.5, that carries one element as a phase.

new.name: Way of Generation and Overcoming
new.effect: Requires all five base elements at purity 10. theme_stats element_affinity_pct, conversion_share_pct, element_ward_pct. Branches The Feeding Ring, The Checking Ring, The Turned Ring. Keystone Turning Phase. 20 nodes, 258 W.

new.name: Two-Bowl Canon
new.effect: Main, Thiên giai, all five elements, so every auxiliary art with an element runs at x0.60. Four ring arts, Banked Heat, Ring's Weakest and Still Water.

new.name: Set a Place
new.effect: Qi ring hit, c_art 2.2, cost 0.10, 1 s.

new.name: Bank the Fire
new.effect: Body ring hit, c_art 2.45, cost 0.10, 2 s.

new.name: Turn the Pillow
new.effect: Qi ring hit, c_art 2.8, cost 0.11, 3 s.

new.name: Turn Down the Lamp
new.effect: Qi ring hit, c_art 5.25, cost 0.25, 6 s.

new.name: Cold Road
new.effect: Escape art, guarded on own health below 30 %.

new.name: The Second Bowl
new.effect: Named chuong: ward strength and efficiency.

new.name: Ward phase
new.effect: A ward holds one element. A hit that generates it is Fed. Combat rule 22, Formulas D. Also serves any element ward and a healer who stands in a phase for an ally.

Should a basic attack ever carry an element without Elemental Fist? The fists counter depends on no.
Is a five-element root meant to be a real path to power, as this assumes?
